item.title: Emergency Services Respond To Multiple Collisions On A427
item.description: Emergency services attended three separate collisions on the A427 between Market Harborough and Corby this morning. item.description: The Air Ambulance Service has unveiled plans to build a new £14 million base near Catthorpe in the Harborough district. item.title: Market Harborough Sculpture Plan Approved Despite Criticism
item.description: Plans for an illuminated sculpture in Market Harborough’s Friendship Park have moved forward after planning permission was approved. item.title: Memorial Bench Honours Much-Loved Street Cleaner
item.description: A new memorial bench has been unveiled in Market Harborough to celebrate the life of a much-loved street cleaner. Billy Kimpton, who died last October aged 73, spent three decades caring for the town’s streets and was widely remembered for his cheerful and positive nature. item.title: Long-Standing Market Harborough Charity Shop to Close
item.description: A long-standing charity shop in Market Harborough is set to close as part of a nationwide shake-up by Cancer Research UK. item.description: Emergency repairs have been made in Rothwell after two elderly people fell on a zebra crossing due to a large pothole and loose cobblestones.
